text:
```yaml
name: Analyze and Package

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      dotnet-version:
        description: 'Dotnet SDK version to use'
        required: false
        default: '7.x'

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ inputs.dotnet-version }}

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Install dpkg (required for DEB packaging)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg

      - name: Run packaging script
        run: pwsh -Command "& {Import-Module tools/packaging/packaging.psm1; Build-PlatformPackages -Verbose}"

      - name: Run packaging validation tests
        run: pwsh -Command "& {Import-Module test/packaging/linux/package-validation.tests.ps1; Invoke-PackageValidationTests -Verbose}"
```
